title: Triage the 10,067 quarantined and 1,479 flagged largelexicon identities left by the target-schema promotion

scope.summary: The v1 to target-schema promotion carried 241,746 of 253,292 source rows. The remaining 11,546 identities are recorded, never dropped: 10,067 quarantined for semantic reasons (risk_flags, root_shape_or_reason) and 1,479 flagged for a structural blocker (crosswalk rows carrying review_fact_id / rebind_provenance / demotion, which the target row schema forbids). This packet dispositions those identities into repair, schema-decision, or accepted-gap states. It changes no committed v1 row and no target schema.
out_of_scope: editing any committed @1 table: they are immutable migration inputs
editing any qamus/schemas/largelexicon-* target schema: weakening a schema to accept legacy output is forbidden
certifying any lexical, morphological or grammatical fact
promoting a quarantined identity to carried without repairing its underlying source row

commands.purpose: read the exact residue population with its source locators, reasons and source-row hashes
re-prove the release is lossless and validation-green before triaging its residue

candidate_population.selection_rule: every identity in quarantined-identities.jsonl (10,067) and flagged-identities.jsonl (1,479); the carried 241,746 are out of scope

expected_outputs.description: one row per residue identity with a terminal triage state and the exact next action
generator, counts per triage state, and the residue ledger hashes this triage was computed against

evidence_policy.statement: Each triage row cites the residue ledger row (family, identity, source_locator, source_row_sha256) and the defect family that quarantined or flagged it. No triage row may assert a linguistic conclusion; a root or surface repair is a proposal for the authoring lane, not a certification.
evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If the correct root, surface or schema disposition is not derivable from committed repository artifacts, emit source_gap with the precise question. Never invent a root for a resemblance and never guess a surface split.

guards: the METHOD of this triage transfers to later migration residue; the linguistic conclusions inside any single row never transfer to another row
risk_flags quarantine means the source row already carries a recorded risk; clearing it requires repairing the source row, not deleting the flag
root_shape_or_reason quarantine is a source-data question: a malformed root needs an authored repair or an explicit no_root_reason, never a normalization guess
the 1,479 flagged crosswalk rows carry review_fact_id / rebind_provenance / demotion payloads: routing them needs an owner schema decision about where that payload belongs, not a silent drop
no triage state may be recorded as carried; only tools/promote_largelexicon_target_schema.py assigns dispositions
defeaters: a proposed repair that would change a committed @1 row in place
a proposed schema relaxation that would let the legacy payload pass the target row schema
a triage row whose identity does not resolve in the residue ledger
a triage row that asserts a root without an authored source

positive.expectation: a lemma-source identity quarantined only for root_shape_or_reason, whose entry already records an authored root, triages to repair_proposed with the exact source locator
a crosswalk identity flagged for additional_property review_fact_id triages to owner_schema_decision_required and names the payload field

adversarial.expectation: a triage run that outputs fewer than 11,546 rows, or any row with a carried state, fails the acceptance test
any diff touching qamus/schemas/largelexicon-* fails the packet

acceptance_tests.name: residue is fully accounted
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: exit 0 and the triage output covers exactly the 11,546 residue identities, each exactly once

acceptance_tests.name: release stays lossless and green
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: ok is true and errors is empty

non_deployment.statement: This packet produces candidate triage rows and repair proposals only. Nothing here reaches a learner surface, mutates the live site, or certifies a linguistic fact; applying any proposed repair is a separate owner-gated authoring step.

conditions: a residue identity requires a target-schema change to resolve
a root or surface repair requires a scholar-level judgement
the flagged crosswalk payload has no correct home outside the row
escalation_trigger.route: owner packet for the schema question; sarf authoring lane for root/surface repairs; docs/blockers.yaml for anything neither can close

definition_of_done: every one of the 11,546 residue identities carries exactly one terminal triage state
no committed @1 table byte and no target schema byte changed
the target release remains lossless with zero silent drops and zero validation violations
each non-terminal identity has an exact follow-on packet or blocker row, never a vague note
